note: Sinh bằng LLM, không lấy từ đề thi IELTS chính thức hay sách luyện thi. Mỗi lệnh gọi ghi ở 'calls'. ID và icon do code gán từ tên, không lấy từ đầu ra model.

topics.name: Daily Routines
questions: What time do you usually wake up on weekdays?
Do you prefer starting your day with exercise or a meal?
How do you typically spend your lunch break at work or school?
What is the last thing you do before going to bed?
Do you often change your daily schedule when the weekend arrives?
Which part of your routine takes the most time each day?

topics.name: Local Environment
questions: Is the area where you live a busy or quiet place?
Do you prefer living in a city center or the suburbs?
What kind of shops are available near your home?
How do you usually travel to your favorite local spots?
Do you think your neighborhood has changed much in recent years?
What is one improvement you would make to your local area?

topics.name: Reading Habits
questions: Do you prefer reading printed books or digital versions?
What type of stories or articles do you enjoy reading most?
When did you last read a book for fun?
Do you read more during holidays or during the school year?
Why do you think some people stop reading in their twenties?
Do you ever recommend books to your friends or family?

topics.name: Culinary Preferences
questions: What is the most popular meal you prepare at home?
Do you prefer eating out with friends or alone?
Have you tried cooking a dish from a different country recently?
What food item do you avoid eating and why?
How often do you shop for groceries in a physical store?
Which cuisine would you like to learn to cook next?

topics.name: Leisure Technology
questions: Which social media platform do you check most frequently?
Do you prefer listening to music or podcasts during your commute?
How much screen time do you typically have on a weekday?
What type of video game would you enjoy playing for fun?
Have you ever stopped using an app you previously loved?
Do you think technology makes leisure activities more or less enjoyable?

topics.name: Gift Selection
questions: What was the best present you received in the past year?
Do you enjoy the process of choosing gifts for others?
What kind of item do you think makes a thoughtful gift?
Have you ever given a gift that someone did not like?
Would you prefer a cash gift or a physical object?
When is the best time of year to buy presents for family?

cue_cards.title: Memorable Gift
cue_cards.text: Describe a gift that you received which you still treasure.
cue_cards.explain: and explain why it remains so important to you.

cue_cards.title: Busy Day Out
cue_cards.text: Describe a time you spent a full day away from home.
cue_cards.explain: and explain how you felt after the trip.

cue_cards.title: Useful App
cue_cards.text: Describe a mobile application that helps you in your daily life.
points: what the app does for you
cue_cards.explain: and explain why you find it so useful.

cue_cards.title: Quiet Place
cue_cards.text: Describe a place in your city where you can relax.
cue_cards.explain: and explain why you enjoy spending time there.

cue_cards.title: First Day at University
cue_cards.text: Describe your first day at university.
cue_cards.explain: and explain how this experience influenced your confidence.

cue_cards.title: A Memorable Meal
cue_cards.text: Describe a memorable meal you have had.
cue_cards.explain: and explain why it left a lasting impression on you.

cue_cards.title: A Challenging Project
cue_cards.text: Describe a challenging project you worked on.
cue_cards.explain: and explain how you felt after completing it.

cue_cards.title: A Favorite Seasonal Festival
cue_cards.text: Describe a favorite seasonal festival you celebrate.
cue_cards.explain: and explain what the festival means to you.

cue_cards.title: A Talented Person
cue_cards.text: Describe a person you know who is particularly talented in a specific skill.
cue_cards.explain: and explain why you admire this individual.

cue_cards.title: Unusual Travel Destination
cue_cards.text: Describe a place you visited that was different from what you expected.
cue_cards.explain: and explain why the experience was surprising.

part2-memorable-gift: Do children today value physical objects more than their parents did?
How have digital platforms changed the way people choose gifts for others?
Why might some individuals prefer receiving experiences over material possessions?
What role do shared memories play in determining the long-term value of a gift?
Will the concept of material ownership become less significant in the future?
part2-busy-day-out: How do short trips away from home influence people's stress levels and overall well‑being?
In what ways do the types of activities people choose on a day trip reflect cultural values or societal trends?
Why might people prefer traveling with friends or family rather than alone for a single‑day outing?
How has the popularity of day‑trips changed compared with longer vacations over the past few decades?
What future developments could make one‑day excursions more accessible or appealing to a wider population?
part2-useful-app: How have mobile applications changed the way people organise their daily schedules compared to a decade ago?
What impact do location‑based services in apps have on consumers' purchasing decisions?
In what ways might reliance on health‑tracking apps affect individuals' attitudes towards personal fitness?
Do you think the growing popularity of multifunctional apps could widen the gap between tech‑savvy and less‑experienced users?
How might future developments in artificial intelligence reshape the role of mobile apps in everyday life?
part2-quiet-place: Do you think urban parks are more effective for mental well-being than indoor recreational facilities?
How have the types of leisure spaces available to city residents changed over the past few decades?
In what ways do social media platforms influence the way people select locations for relaxation?
Is it likely that private relaxation spaces will become less important in the future due to remote work trends?
What role does access to green spaces play in reducing inequality in urban environments?
part2-first-day-at: What kinds of social events do universities typically organize to help new students settle in?
Do you think first-year students today face more academic pressure than those from previous generations?
In what ways does moving away from home affect a young person's sense of independence?
Should universities provide specific mental health support during a student's initial weeks on campus?
How might virtual learning environments change the traditional experience of starting university?
part2-memorable-meal: How do the ingredients used in traditional family feasts differ from those in modern restaurants?
Do you think people appreciate communal dining more than they did in previous generations?
In what ways has technology changed the way individuals socialize around food?
Why might some cultures prioritize the emotional significance of a meal over its nutritional value?
Do you believe that the importance of shared meals will decline as lifestyles become more individualistic?
part2-challenging: What specific skills do people need to overcome unexpected technical problems?
Are modern teams better at handling complex issues than those from previous generations?
Why do some individuals struggle more with high-pressure work environments than others?
How might the nature of workplace challenges change as artificial intelligence becomes common?
Is it possible to be truly successful in one's career without facing major setbacks?
part2-favorite: How do communities typically organize activities during seasonal festivals?
In what ways do traditional foods influence the celebration of seasonal festivals?
Why do people tend to gather with family and friends during these festivals?
How have modern technologies changed the way seasonal festivals are observed compared with the past?
What impact might the commercialization of seasonal festivals have on cultural identity in the future?
part2-talented-person: What factors contribute to a person developing exceptional talent in a particular skill?
How does the learning environment influence the speed at which someone acquires a specific ability?
In what ways do cultural attitudes shape the recognition and encouragement of gifted individuals?
How have opportunities for nurturing talent changed compared with a generation ago?
What impact might advances in technology have on the future development of specialized skills?
part2-unusual-travel: What factors usually cause tourists' expectations to differ from the reality of a destination?
How do travel guides and media influence people's preconceived ideas about places they have never visited?
In what ways can unexpected experiences while traveling affect a traveller's attitude towards future trips?
How might cultural differences between visitors and locals shape the perception of a place’s authenticity?
Do you think the rise of virtual reality tours will change how people form expectations about real-world locations in the future?

selection_rule.part1: Mỗi bộ đề lấy đúng part1_topics_per_set chủ đề. Loại trước các chủ đề trùng đề tài với cue card của bộ (giao từ nội dung từ 4 ký tự trở lên), rồi ưu tiên chủ đề đang được dùng ít nhất để sáu chủ đề xuất hiện đều nhau, và không lặp lại một cặp chủ đề đã dùng ở bộ khác.
selection_rule.part2: Mỗi cue card đúng một bộ đề, theo thứ tự trong bank.
selection_rule.part3: Câu Part 3 trong bộ đề là KHO DỰ PHÒNG (UC-05). Khi thi, agent sinh câu Part 3 bám câu trả lời thật của thí sinh (P6a3); kho này chỉ dùng khi không bám được ý nào, và không dùng để đo tiêu chí nghiệm thu UC-04.
selection_rule.per_session: Trong một phiên, chọn benchmark.part1_questions_per_topic câu trong số questions_per_topic câu của mỗi chủ đề, theo seed của phiên. Cấu trúc đề cố định ở mức bank, phần đổi giữa các phiên là tập con câu hỏi.
